sync_recordings.label: Sync recordings with disk on startup and once a day.

expire_interval.label: Number of minutes to wait between cleanup runs.

pre_capture.label: Seconds to retain before event starts.

post_capture.label: Seconds to retain after event ends.

pre_capture.label: Seconds to retain before event starts.

post_capture.label: Seconds to retain after event ends.

pipeline.label: Recording pipeline settings (global only, except recorder_stale_timeout).

processing_timeout.label: Seconds a continuous segment waits for frame processing before it is moved with unknown activity stats (0 waits indefinitely, as upstream).

move_concurrency.label: Most segment probes and copies the mover runs at once (0 is unbounded, as upstream).

max_cached_segments.label: Closed segments kept in the cache per camera and variant before the oldest are discarded.

cache_free_reserve.label: Percent of the cache filesystem kept free by discarding the oldest closed segments (0 is off, as upstream).

async_db_writes.label: Write segment rows from a background writer instead of blocking the mover (false is upstream).

db_write_queue.label: Most segment rows the background writer holds before the mover waits.

db_flush_timeout.label: Seconds the background writer drains queued rows on shutdown.

reconcile_on_unclean_shutdown.label: After an unclean shutdown, add rows for recent segment files that have none (false is upstream).

reconcile_window.label: Hours of recordings the unclean-shutdown recovery scans.

recorder_watchdog.label: Signal the camera watchdog judges recorders by: their cache output, or the mover's messages (upstream).

recorder_stale_timeout.label: Seconds without new output before a recorder is restarted.

empty_directory_cleanup.label: Remove only the directories a cleanup run deleted from, or walk the whole recordings tree (full, upstream).

enabled_in_config.label: Keep track of original state of recording.
